name: No Hooting Around
tagline: A focus tool that blocks distracting content, not whole sites, for people with ADHD and everyone else.
problem: Focus apps block whole apps or sites instead of specific distracting content; the team cites ADHD prevalence.
solution: Analyses page content with an LLM and blocks distracting material while allowing the useful parts, with an owl mascot.
demo_moment: Team-described: open a video site for a lecture and see recommendations hidden.

lessons: A precise improvement on an existing tool category can win accessibility.
